title: 5.1 nth Roots and Rational Exponents

icans: I can find nth roots of numbers.
I can evaluate expressions with rational exponents.
I can solve equations using nth roots.

blocks.p: Find every real number that makes each equation true.
Rule: an equation xⁿ = a has two real solutions when ______________________, one when ______________________, and none when ______________________
By the Power of a Power Property, (9^(1/2))² = 9¹ = 9. So 9^(1/2) must be ________. In the same way, 8^(1/3) must be ________.

blocks.sec: Part 2 · Notes and examples (fill in each note, then work the example)

notes: Real nth roots: If n is odd, a has exactly ________ real nth root.
Real nth roots: If n is even and a > 0, a has ________ real nth roots. If n is even and a < 0, a has ________ real nth roots.
